summary.text: Dean Roy is the Freedom and Unity Party candidate for governor, a party he created. The Associated Press (via Fortune) described him in March 2026 as a freshman at Stowe High School and the first candidate for governor under age 18 on Vermont's general-election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Dean Roy, who has said his political ambitions started in the eighth grade, worked as a legislative page at the Vermont Statehouse.
He says he does not identify with either major party and names housing as the most important issue facing the state.
Roy secured his place on the general-election ballot by creating the Freedom and Unity Party.
Vermont's constitution sets no minimum age for gubernatorial candidates and requires only that they have lived in the state for four years.
He has said, "I don't expect necessarily to win," but that he hopes to start a movement that brings more young people into politics.

sources.title: Meet the 14-year-old running for governor of Vermont
